status: Implementation fixes completed; physical accuracy and exact template matching remain partially unverified

dataIsolation.deviceTesting: User-authorized physical camera/microphone checks used a separate temporary MongoDB and loopback services. Capture stopped, the fixture exited, and temporary recordings were discarded. Only metadata evidence remains.
dataIsolation.training: Device-test consent explicitly excluded training. No recordings or recruitment records were reused for research, no consent was fabricated, and no trained production integrity model was created.
dataIsolation.uiTesting: Synthetic Candidate, Company and HR accounts used two disposable fixture instances. Normal recruitment records were not changed.

confirmed: Physical USB webcam and Realtek microphone preview worked; microphone meter changed.
Candidate device recording saved two independent WebM segments and stopped successfully.
Both clips fully decoded as 640x480 VP8 with mono 48 kHz Opus: 30.00 and 17.34 seconds of audio, 713 and 414 video frames.
Browser playback reached the first segment's end without a media error; the user reported clear video and speech.
The interviewer tab decoded the candidate's incoming video at 640x480 in the same-computer WebRTC session.
Optional local speaker analysis returned one sustained cluster for the second clip. This is one observation, not speaker-detection accuracy.
notPassed: Local Whisper base.en did not reproduce the intended script: the first transcript was empty and the second said Thank you. Actual spoken content could not be established from the expected script alone; no word-error-rate claim was made.
A requested clean retry did not produce a new segment visible in the refreshed test recording list, so it was not counted as a successful retry.
Interviewer microphone permission requests repeatedly timed out. No interviewer recording or two-way audible conversation was verified.
Two independent physical devices on different networks, remote participant audio audibility, overlapping speakers and multi-person speaker accuracy remain unverified.
fixed: Recorder startup failure no longer leaves Stop and save hanging.
Late capture creation cannot start recording after leaving, unmounting, or withdrawing consent.
Audio-only MIME selection, ended/replaced devices, recorder errors, concurrent stop and upload retry have regression coverage.
Blank speech-service results become explicit failed, retryable transcripts instead of blank ready results. Unreviewed text can be re-transcribed; reviewed evidence is protected.
Playback failures have a visible error message.
After failed recognition, refreshing the clip revision preserves a typed manual transcript so reviewed saves do not fail with a stale-version conflict.

proctoring.confirmed: Real local face processing initialized and passed its one-face preflight. Seven sustained no-face events, approximately 5.2 seconds each against the existing five-second threshold, reached the isolated server after the controlled absence/cover checks.
proctoring.limits: Event timestamps were retained, but physical-action timing was not independently ground-truthed. Event delivery does not establish detection accuracy, multiple-face sensitivity, or false-positive rates.
proctoring.gaze: Two real-device calibration attempts stopped with insufficient clear eye images. No gaze estimates were accepted; no thresholds were weakened. Gaze remains experimental and accuracy-unvalidated.
proctoring.fixed: Frozen frames now show paused/unavailable status instead of indefinitely active. Delayed results from replaced camera tracks or earlier admission state are ignored. Current zero/multiple-face estimates are visible locally.

integrityResearch.implemented: Explicit research-consent provenance/withdrawal/expiry, independent labels and adjudication, empty collection template, preflight, participant-disjoint training, baselines, calibration, clustered uncertainty intervals and device/browser slices.
integrityResearch.result: No legitimate reviewed research dataset existed. Empty data is correctly rejected; no real-data model was trained. Research artifacts remain deploymentApproved:false and do not change recruitment scoring.

aiQuality.result: Final 18-case synthetic resume/JD and interview-report corpus passed after corrections; baseline and intermediate failures are preserved.
aiQuality.limits: A small synthetic regression corpus is not real-world hiring accuracy, fairness, or general model reliability validation. Existing stored assessments were not silently rewritten.

confirmed: Ninety-five route/layout observations across public, Candidate, Company and HR screens at 390, 768 and 1440 CSS-pixel widths; no document-level horizontal overflow in those observations.
Representative resume/profile, signup, application-evidence, job-creation and interview-preflight screens visually inspected in light/dark combinations; screenshots saved.
Mobile navigation traps focus and Escape returns it to its opener. Application dialog and notification Escape also return focus correctly.
Theme selection survives reload/navigation; unsaved form input survives theme switching.
Signup/filter selected states are announced. Shared field labels exclude help text from control names and preserve existing descriptions.
Flat-surface input borders/focus and text/status token contrast checks pass.
Unexpected render/page-module failures now have accessible user-controlled recovery instead of a blank page.
ui.referenceLimits: User selected Amber Video Editor. Both official Hostinger live-preview URLs failed with ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID; no certificate bypass was attempted. Exact 7Heven/Amber layout, fonts and colors cannot be confirmed without accessible references or screenshots.
ui.otherLimits: Fresh browser checks used Codex's Chromium in-app browser. Physical mobile, Firefox/WebKit, screen-reader speech and OS reduced-motion behavior remain unverified. Reduced-motion CSS and first-paint theme behavior have source/unit coverage. Some route snapshots were loading or expected role-denied states; these are not counted as full visual inspection of loaded content.

projectChecks.fullSuite: npm run check passed: production build and 313 tests across 26 files. This preceded the final MediaReview stale-version fix.
projectChecks.finalChange: After that final isolated fix, npm run build passed and 36 relevant tests across six files passed, including the new failed-transcription-to-manual-save regression. No later source edits remain.
projectChecks.health: Doctor passed: normal database ping and API health200. Provider configuration health is not proof of speech quality or cross-network calling.
